LESSON: OUR MARKET

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social environment
Topic 1.6: Our market
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our market, part of Social environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can you locate your local market?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Our market together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Integrity: learner enhances honest and fair negotiations when role playing on buying and selling.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Citizenship: learner enhances acknowledgement for self and others as they interact with people found in the market.

● Financial literacy: learner develops spending skills as they visit the nearest market to observe different activities that take place.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Buying and selling in the market can be used to learn the concept of money in Mathematics Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials, local environment, flash cards, braille cards, pictures, digital devices with assistive devices, shop corner,

market items.
